short_description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore to SC/ST and Women borrowers for setting up greenfield enterprises.
purpose: Promoting entrepreneurship among SC/ST and Women communities by facilitating bank loans for greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or trading.

benefits_summary.security: Primary security on assets financed, Credit Guarantee Fund for Stand-Up India (CGFSI)

sources.source_name: Stand-Up Mitra Portal / DFS Ministry of Finance
sources.document_reference: Stand-Up India Guidelines (Extended up to 2025), DFS
sources.notes: Margin money revised from 25% to up to 15% with eligible convergence subsidies.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
Applicant must be an SC/ST individual or a Woman entrepreneur. For non-individual enterprises, 51% of shareholding and controlling stake must be held by SC/ST or Women.
Borrower must be establishing a greenfield (first-time) enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or trading.
Borrower should not be in default to any bank or financial institution.

documents.document_name: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport)

documents.description: Official caste certificate issued by competent revenue authority
Technical and financial viability report for the greenfield enterprise

documents.document_name: Proof of Business Address / Lease Agreement
documents.description: Rent agreement or title deed for proposed business location
